decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has had its own dedicated page for two consecutive years, which signals favorable resolved uncertainty and justifies continued commitment, and for a small-batch in-house producer it costs little to keep.

The hyaluronic serum is a low-cost option to keep open: it has stayed listed for two years, and the cleansing milk was already cut, yet B has never been promoted, so its value is still uncertain but not clearly negative.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and appears to have replaced the dropped cleansing milk, so its uncertainty is still unresolved and keeping this cheap option open is worthwhile.
